prompt.project_info: Create a realistic first-person pillow-height morning bedroom candid.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with delicate features, long straight slightly messy black hair, gentle relaxed sleepy smile, and fresh natural appearance, wearing light-colored opaque cotton loungewear.
prompt.composition_elements: First-person view from pillow height as an approved adult partner lies in bed, hands resting naturally on bed or beside pillow, face near top of frame, white wrinkled bedding, blurred quilt edges, no third-person camera angle.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft scattered early-morning window light through pale curtains, low contrast, slight focus softness and highlight bloom, clean gentle real-life moment.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic first-person smartphone perspective, shallow depth of field, realistic skin tone, delicate soft focus, natural proportions and subtle texture.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A realistic vertical first-person morning bedroom candid from pillow height, as an approved adult partner lies in bed and looks up. An approved adult woman with delicate features, long straight slightly messy black hair, and a gentle sleepy smile leans near the top of frame with her hands resting naturally on the bed or beside the pillow. She wears light-colored opaque cotton loungewear. White bedding is slightly wrinkled, quilt or pillow edges blur in the foreground, and soft scattered window light passes through pale curtains. Use low contrast, slight focus softness, delicate highlight bloom, realistic skin, natural proportions, and a gentle accidental real-life glimpse without a third-person camera angle.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, lingerie, transparent clothing, vulgar pose, voyeuristic framing, nudity, heavy dreamy filter, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, public figure likeness.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required environment reference. Preserve two-adult first-person context, approved-adult identity, hair, bedding, pale loungewear, and morning light; replace identity or clothing with approved equivalents while retaining opaque coverage. No typography or logo is required.
